full_panel.description:
The bounded primary is the original Figures4-6 projection-specific choice-information family: Figure4b-e pairwise raw/conditional correlations and interaction information, single-neuron correct/error choice information and pair classes; Figure5c,d empirical signed triplets/clustering, h-i source two-pool interpretation and j-k choice-selectivity pools; Figure6d-e model-derived structured information and the three independent/unstructured/structured information curves. Retain same-target/nonlabeled and correct/incorrect contrasts and relevant ACC/RSC/cPPC strata. Indispensable support includes Figure2 source-fit evidence and relevant Figure3 single-neuron/movement evidence, source spatial-distance control (Extended Data5c), correlation-destroying trial shuffles (Extended Data5h/6c), projection-stratified companions (Extended Data5/6) and the nonsymmetric population-information check (Extended Data8d, with relevant weight/IPM interpretation). This is not every paper figure, every task-variable comparison or every extended-data simulation. The sole scalar finding is a rounded source summary, so the full native primary panel is not covered by scalar/categorical v1. Required observation/graph/curve artifacts and exact source identities remain unresolved.
